answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 41 epochs. Receipts are issued in orchard, burned on slash in nebula, and listed in bridge. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 215 aliases cost 258 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
